LanguageData.HD_HAM_Greeting: This is the {0} HAM operator. Your signal is clear. How are things at your settlement?
LanguageData.HD_HAM_MissionReceived: A rumor picked up during HAM chatter has led to a new mission. Check the quests tab.
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Chatter1: The wind has been picking up here all morning. How is the weather at your settlement?
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Chatter2: We have been comparing homemade antennas on this band. A little more height can make quite a difference.
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Chatter3: A caravan cook shared a recipe with me. The signal broke up just as they mentioned the last ingredient.
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Chatter4: An operator nearby has been telling stories about life in their settlement. Sounds like they have had a busy week.
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Chatter5: Your signal is coming through clearly. Thanks for helping me check the receiver.
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Chatter6: It is always good to exchange call signs with another settlement. The band has been fairly quiet today.
LanguageData.HD_HAM_Rumor: Come to think of it, I heard someone out there could use a hand. Let me pass along what I know.
